items.title: Entre-Ijuís (RS) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 28 #9
items.en_title: Entre-Ijuís (RS) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 28 #9
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Entre-Ijuís (RS) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 14,901.65; proposals close Nov 28, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
